_readme: EXAMPLE FORMAT ONLY — three illustrative records, NOT the CP-31 corpus.
The authoritative CP-31 sheet is 31 problems x 12 rating buckets (800-1900)
= 372 problems. That structure was read from the signed-in sheet page
To supply the real corpus, replace this file's `problems` array with the
authoritative export and save it as data/sources/cp31.json, then run:
The importer is shape-tolerant: a raw API response, a bare array, or a
{data:[...]} wrapper all work unmodified. Only an identifier and a rating
are required per row; titles/tags are resolved from the Codeforces API.
